name: KromiumProxyManager
description: Facade for managing the proxy settings of the browser at runtime without restarting the browser engine or recreating the browser instance.
whenToUse: Access via browser.proxyManager to dynamically update proxy routing for an active browser instance.

methods.name: updateProxy
methods.description: Dynamically updates the proxy for this browser session.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumBrowser
import org.daviante.kromium.api.proxy.KromiumProxy

fun switchProxy(browser: KromiumBrowser, proxyHost: String, proxyPort: Int) {
    val proxy = KromiumProxy.http(proxyHost, proxyPort)
    val success = browser.proxyManager.updateProxy(proxy)
    println("Proxy switch success: $success")
}
